name: Psilocybin
description: Compound found in some mushrooms; trials use purified, lab-made psilocybin

items.label: Major depression
items.detail: One dose vs niacin; vs SSRI

note.text: The developer reports two Phase 3 trials met their main goals; neither has posted results or been published.

bullets: **Psilocin,** the active metabolite, is believed to act on serotonin 2A receptors
**In 8 volunteers,** oral psilocybin occupied up to 72% of brain 5-HT2A receptors
**Effect intensity** tracked receptor occupancy and blood psilocin levels
**How it may affect depression** is not established
Given once or twice, with psychological support

practical.routes: By mouth, once or twice, with psychological support (trials)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Converted to psilocin, its active metabolite
practical.soldAs: Not available as a medicine; state-licensed services (OR, CO)
practical.monitored: Depression scores (MADRS), suicidal thoughts, side effects
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status not stated

regulatory.text: Not approved; COMP360 NDA in progress (company)

references: N Engl J Med, Goodwin et al., single-dose psilocybin for resistant depression, Nov 2022
JAMA, Raison et al., single-dose psilocybin for major depression, Sep 2023
Neuropsychopharmacology, Madsen et al., psilocybin and 5-HT2A occupancy, Jun 2019
